skillset.skill: 10s CT - 2000% Water DMG (PHY). Increase own Arts by 30.
skillset.arts: 10000% Water DMG (PHY). For 35s, redirect Allies' DMG taken to self and gain a DMG barrier that negates 35000 DMG to self. Additionally if used during Demonic Blood Awakening, cleanse 1 DMG RES debuff from self.
skillset.truearts: 57000% Water DMG (PHY). For 20s, reduce enemies' Water RES and PHY RES by 60%. Additionally if used during Demonic Blood Awakening, extend current Demonic Blood Awakening's duration by 40s.
skillset.superarts:
Enter Demonic Blood Awakening for 120s.
If used during Demonic Blood Awakening: 150000% Water DMG (PHY). For 45s, increase allies' DMG by 150% (stackable).

passive.ability1: During Demonic Blood Awakening, increase own DMG RES by 40%, CRI RES by 60%, and Freeze RES and Paralysis RES by 100%.
passive.ability2: Increase own Arts by [2 x # of Demon allies currently alive]/s (MAX: 8/s). At Start of Quest, increase own Arts by [50 x # of Human allies] (MAX: 150).
passive.ability3: Increase own DMG against enemies in BREAK by 20%.
